pretreatment: standard Radio Corporation of America cleaning
evidence: Thin HZO ﬁlms with various cation ratios were deposited by ALD on Si(100) substrates with a resistivity of 1–10 Ω cm and thermally grown SiO2 (500 nm) on Si substrate, respectively. A commercial system (BENEQ TFS-200) with a warm-wall reactor was used to prepare the samples. The native oxide on the Si wafer surface was removed by a standard Radio Corporation of America cleaning.
